subject: the boundary document itself
current_state: DRAFT / AWAITING HUMAN AND SCIENTIFIC REVIEW
rationale: It is version 0.1.0-draft and declares itself draft awaiting human and scientific review. Two gates block on its approval.

subject: the clinical warning text, both languages
rationale: The warning is what stands between a traceable attention finding and a reader taking it as advice. Its exact wording, in both languages, is the thing being approved - not its gist.

subject: the eleven prohibited claim categories
rationale: The scanner enforces exactly this list. A category nobody thought of is a category nothing blocks.

subject: the permitted input kinds
rationale: Five input kinds are permitted and all are synthetic, public or protocol-defined. This is the control that keeps real genotype and patient data out, and it should be read as such.

subject: the enabled operation modes
rationale: No production or clinical mode is enabled. Approving the boundary is not approving clinical use, and the form says so.
